install.title: Carry Omnidance in your pocket
install.body: Install the app to enter straight from your home screen - no browser and faster.
install.iosBody: In Safari tap the Share button and choose «Add to Home Screen». That way you enter directly, like an app.
install.androidBody: In Chrome tap the ⋮ menu and choose «Install app» or «Add to Home Screen». That way you enter directly, like an app.
